title: Ghostline
summary: Payment-channel toolkit for agent API calls on Ootle: cumulative off-chain vouchers, HTTP 402 quotes, spending policies, CLI, Rust/TypeScript support and MCP tools. October 19 source review found release v0.3.1 and a hosted static motion explainer, not a live payment interface. The maintainer links Esmeralda settlement/refund evidence; service-side ledgers record call counts separately. Services see requests, prices and vouchers; fees, timing, channel metadata and funding links remain public. The experimental pooled close is not coordinator-private. Esmeralda testnet only; Linux x86-64 CLI releases. MIT. No software installation, wallet, paid call or transaction was performed in this catalog review.
cardSummary: Explore payment channels that let AI agents pay per API call using cumulative vouchers and one settlement.
creator: AduAkorful

recording.credit: Concept overview — Hosted static motion explainer; no wallet, paid call or transaction performed.
